dogecoin.text:
Maybe we'll finally see Doge become mainstream. Fingers crossed! 

#Dogecoin #SpaceX #ElonMusk

Man, this whole Dogecoin thing is wild! I gotta say,  I think SpaceX could be the key to it all. Elon Musk always throws out those cryptic tweets about Doge, and now they're gonna launch a satellite with a literal Doge on it? That just screams "mainstream acceptance" to me.
